findings.statement: In a deterministic affine-priority REL_INC gauge, the two scalar target bits require only 7/7 pair coefficients on 5x3-k3, 30/6 on 4x4-k4, and 71/127 on 6x3-k3; affine-control 3x7-k3 requires zero pair coefficients. These supports are fitted coordinate representatives, not structural laws.
A frozen 28-bit component-summary bilinear bank is globally exact on 5x3-k3 but remains inexact on 4x4-k4 and 6x3-k3 even with exact-rank coefficient grading.

On 6x3-k3, grading the simple bilinear bank by rank mod 3 reduces scalar contradictions from 368 to 4; rank mod 6 and exact rank leave the same four contradictions. Thus the three-phase coordinate is load-bearing there, while finer rank phase is not the missing information.
On 4x4-k4, the simple bilinear bank retains 96 contradictions under rank-mod-3, rank-mod-6, and exact-rank grading. Missing internal topology, not finer phase, is the dominant obstruction.

Residual/column topology alone is scalar-exact on 5x3-k3 but not 4x4-k4 or 6x3-k3; progressively restoring frontier-relative delay information monotonically reduces the remaining scalar contradictions.
On 6x3-k3, topology plus residual-cell delay parity is scalar-exact with zero contradictions, although it omits two structural interaction dimensions relative to the full degree-2 span.

On 4x4-k4, topology plus frontier/not-frontier leaves 38 contradictions, topology plus delay parity leaves 16, and topology plus 0/1/2+ delay buckets leaves 12. Exact frontier-relative delay is the first tested topology-delay coordinate with zero contradictions.

Across 5x3-k3, 4x4-k4, and 6x3-k3, full REL_INC remains the current common scalar-exact pair coordinate; geometry-specific coarser quotients exist but do not yet yield one universal compact timing label.

nonclaims: The canonical fitted pair supports are not promoted as structural syndrome formulas.
Rank mod 3 is not yet proven sufficient for the final topology-aware syndrome law.
Exact relative delay may still admit a different structural quotient not present in EW-RS-041.
next_question: Does the predeclared F/O/E release-parity topology candidate retain exact scalar value across all demanding carriers, especially 4x4-k4?
